On the third of November, among kelp and gull feathers at the tide line, she found a green bottle sealed with candle wax. Inside, rolled tight as a secret, was a note: 'To whoever finds this — I was not lonely when I wrote it. I was hopeful, and hope is a thing you can mail to strangers.' No name, just a salt smudge and a small drawing of a lighthouse that was not hers. Mara laughed, cried a little, then wrote beneath the stranger's words: 'Received with thanks. Hope delivered.' She threw the bottle back into the current, toward whoever kept the next light.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。街灯把空荡的柏油路照成一条淡金色的河。写字楼次第熄灯，只剩几扇窗固执地亮着，像失眠者的眼睛。环卫工的扫帚声在楼宇间轻轻回响，二十四小时便利店透出温热的光，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处传来首班公交的低鸣，天边泛起一丝极淡的青灰。这座白天喧腾的城市，此刻安静得像一张还未写上答案的试卷。", "w03": "• Imagine you're hunting for a lost sock: you open one drawer, and inside there's a smaller box to search.\n• Searching that smaller box is the same job, just smaller — so you do it the same way again: open it, and look for an even smaller box inside.\n• Keep going until you reach a box with nothing inside it — that's where you stop, check it, and work your way back out, drawer by drawer."}
